2026-11-25.1.note: TD-718 repair (owner ruling 2026-11-25). (1) freshness.py: in the household-wide STR de-dupe an approved STR (current / unconfirmed), or a rejected one, is never superseded by an STR that is neither (not_approved, wrong_type, unreadable, stale, future, unknown); genuineness still leads; non-STR ranking unchanged. (2) str_route.py: the approved test is strict - whole-word 'lulus', 'diluluskan', 'kekal kelulusan asal' (any spacing) or 'approve'; 'tidak lulus' joins the rejected words (checked first). So 'Dalam Proses Kelulusan' reads not_approved, 'Menunggu Kelulusan' unreadable. Bumped although 2026-11-24.1 was never published: the rule is never re-seed a digest without a bump, and a new number keeps the two behaviours apart in the learning loop.

2026-11-25.2.note: TD-718 repair round 2 (owner ruling 2026-11-25). (1) freshness.py: the household STR de-dupe ranks three tiers after genuineness - 2 approved (current / unconfirmed), 1 rejected and unreadable (between them has-a-date, recency, upload decide, as before TD-718), 0 every other state (not_approved, wrong_type, stale, future, blank / unknown). So a rejection under one member no longer buries a newer unread (amber) page under another, a failing page never buries an unread page, and an approval holds against a rejection filed under another member whatever the dates (same slot: a rejection still replaces it through promotion.should_promote). (2) str_route.py: 'tidak diluluskan' and 'not approve' join the rejected words, so 'Tidak Diluluskan' / 'Not Approved' read rejected, not approved. Bumped again although 2026-11-25.1 was never published: CLAUDE.md, never re-seed a digest without a bump.

2026-11-25.5.note: TD-718 repair round 5. freshness.py + str_route.py: in the household STR de-dupe tier 2 needs, besides the check's own 'match', the page's OWN recipient name or NRIC to hit a household member's IC card (str_route.str_recipient_hits_a_household_card: the same _str_recipient_household_match call as _read_str_check, taken without the IC-number chain).
